content: Normality is a paved road: It's comfortable to walk, but no flowers grow on it.
author: Vincent van Gogh
story:
Rather than offering a polite platitude, this observation challenges how we navigate our inner lives. From childhood, we are trained to fit in, to smooth over our eccentricities, and to mirror the expectations of those around us. But copying others only buys superficial acceptance at the cost of your own soul.

Across his life and work, Vincent van Gogh saw how easily we surrender our tranquility to fear, vanity, and distraction. Your unique perspective and lived contradictions are your greatest offering to the world. The moment you stop performing and stand firmly in your own skin, you command an authority that imitation can never manufacture.
reflectionPrompt: How can you welcome mistakes and awkward beginnings as essential steps in your creative evolution?
